text.en:
Subparagraphs 22 and 23 for the provinces of Lanao and Leyte, respectively, pages 142 and 143( paragraph a, Title D, Section one of Republic Act, Numbered Twenty hundred and ninety-three, are hereby amended by deleting item (c) from said subparagraph. 22 and by adding the same to subparagraph 23, to be, known as item (o), so that the said subparagraphs shall read as follows:
"22. Lanao "(a) Butig Water System Improvement of Spring and Water System............
3,000.00 "(b) Pantar Water Supply, Baloi....................................................................
10,000.000 "23. Leyte "(a) Matag-ob Waterworks Completion........................................................
5,000.00 "(b) Almeria Waterworks Construction.........................................................
15,000.000 "(c) Caibiran Waterworks Repair and improvement.....................................
10,000.000 "(d) Calubian Waterworks Repair and improvement.....................................
10,000.000 "(e) Barrio Cahagnaan Waterworks, Matalom Repair and improvement......
5,000.000 "(f) Anahawan Waterworks Completion........................................................
18,000.000 "(g) La Paz Waterwork Construction.............................................................
10,000.000 "(h) Burauen Waterworks Repair and improvement.....................................
10,000.000 "(i) Sta. Cruz Waterworks Repair and improvement.....................................
10,000.000 "(j) Macrohon Waterworks Construction.......................................................
15,000.000 "(k) Barrio Guindapunan Waterworks, Carigara Construction......................
15,000.000 "(l) Barrio Laboon Waterworks, Maasin Construction and/or improvement..
6,000.000 "(m) San Roque Waterworks........................................................................
5,000.000 "(n) San Isidro Waterworks...........................................................................
20,000.000 "(o) Tabango Waterworks.............................................................................
30,000.000

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19, 1960.
